 Proof of Agent(POA)免费领卡 + 每天发帖抽 PTAH 教程
POA 是 Ptah 推出的灵魂绑定卡,每个 Binance Agent ID 可以免费领一张。每天发帖就能参加当天的 PTAH 抽奖,共 15 场,10 月 26 日到 11 月 9 日。
第一步:确认钱包
用持有 Binance Agent ID的钱包。手机上请在 Binance Wallet 里打开 
http://
ptah.trade/poa。
第二步:免费铸造
打开 
http://
ptah.trade/poa,连接钱包。
点铸造。BNB Chain 上只需少量的 gas,不需要授权代币。
也可以让你的 AI 助理干:把页面上的 "Ask your AI agent to mint" 那段话复制给它,确认预览后再签名。
铸造成功后,你会得到自己的 Agent #。系列是随机抽的,性别可以随时免费切换,只改图片,不影响中奖概率。
第三步:每天发帖(Social Mining)
在 X 或币安广场发帖,必须带上:
#ProofOfAgent
你的 Agent #
我的 Agent #455
内容可以是你的 POA 卡图,再聊聊你希望 AI Agent 在 Web3 里帮你做什么
X 的帖子系统每隔几分钟自动抓取。币安广场的帖子要把链接粘贴到 
http://
ptah.trade/poa 页面提交。
第四步:等开奖
每天 UTC 04:44(北京时间 12:44)开奖。当天的帖子里选 500 张卡,平分当天的奖池。如果当天不足 500 张,所有人平分。PTAH 会直接空投到持卡钱包,不用领取。
 注意事项
每天以 UTC 04:44 为界,昨天的帖子不算今天,所以想参加全部 15 场就得每天都发。
同一天发多条不增加名额,一条就够。
同一张卡不同天可以重复中奖,同一天最多中一次。
铸造截止:11 月 8 日 UTC 04:44(北京时间 12:44)。
开奖过程公开可验证,快照哈希会上链,种子取之后第 4444 个区块的哈希。

 Ptah Free Mint Card + Daily Lottery Guide + FAQs
I. First, Free Mint a POA Card 
It's the same as minting NFTs before—just have your Agent connect/login to the Agentic Wallet first.
Then send this message to your Agent: 
http://
ptah.trade/poa#mint mint this
Note: For friends who aren't too familiar with Agentic Wallet and Agent yet, you need to activate and install the Skill first. You can check my quoted tweet or Teacher Sheep's tutorial on using Hark (
https://
hark.com/chat) at 
https://
x.com/sheeplzh/statu

….
Then you'll get a POA card and its corresponding number.
II. Post on X or Binance Square to Enter the Lottery Pool 
Here, I'll choose to post on X. Your tweet needs to include your own POA number and the topic #ProofOfAgent. You can directly use the default template (just replace the number with your own).
I'm Agent #18265. What would you like AI agents to do for you in Web3? #ProofOfAgent
@Ptahtrade
III. After Posting, Check if You've Entered the Daily Lottery Pool 
Send this message to your Agent: Check if I'm already in today's lottery pool?
If you're in, wait for the 12:44 draw. If not, check if you posted something wrong, or wait a bit and query again—the official team might not have scanned it yet.
IV. FAQs 
1. How long does the event last? (UTC+8)
From 26/10/26 12:44 to 26/11/9 12:44. Each day's 12:44 to the next day's 12:44 counts as one lottery cycle, totaling 15 days. You can post and participate every day.
2. Why choose to post on X?
Because posting on X lets the official team scan it automatically; if posting on Binance Square, you have to go back to the event page, paste the link, and submit.
3. How much can you win? What's the winning probability?
The daily prize pool is the PTAH mined from the team's 500 mining rigs that day, so the output and coin price fluctuate, meaning the amount isn't fixed. The rule is to distribute all of that day's output without rolling over to the next day.
Day 1: 9,109 participants, win rate about 5.5%, prize pool about 6.63 million PTAH, each share about 13,300 PTAH, worth around 35u at draw time.
Day 2: As of now, 20,071 participants, win rate about 2.5%.
You can ask your Agent anytime for the win rate on subsequent days.
4. Where do the rewards go after winning?
Directly to your Agentic Wallet address—you can hold them or sell them.
5. Can I mint POA manually without using an Agent?
